items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I remember one night when Benny Goodman and Chick Webb had a battle of music... I'm working there and I couldn't even get in to hear them.

ctx.x: Ziggy Elman. That was Goodman's trumpet section.
Now, they finished. They were at the Pennsylvania Hotel, I believe. I get through at 4. They used to come by the Ubangi Club and sit there, and, you know, listen to me
